title: Load-Out Minimums, Notice and Truck Charges, Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
Moving grain out of a licensed house takes scale time and truck room, and the terms on which an order is taken differ across the six programmes of Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements. They are posted here.

## Rule

The programme an agreement is written under fixes the smallest load-out the elevator will schedule in whole bushels, the business days of notice a load-out needs before it is scheduled, the charge raised for each truck loaded out, and the charge raised for a load-out taken outside the posted load-out hours.

## Posted load-out terms

| Programme | Smallest load-out (bu) | Notice (business days) | Charge for each truck (USD) | Out-of-hours charge (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 1000 | 1 | 0.00 | 45.00 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 500 | 1 | 15.00 | 45.00 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 5000 | 2 | 15.00 | 60.00 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 5000 | 2 | 15.00 | 60.00 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 10000 | 3 | 15.00 | 75.00 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 15000 | 5 | 25.00 | 125.00 |

## The same terms, condition by condition

| If the agreement is written under | then an order must name at least | and the notice that must run is | and each truck carries | and an out-of-hours order carries |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| the two lowest programmes | 1000 bushels, or 500 on the Grain Bank Deposit Account | 1 business day | nil on the Open Storage Account, 15.00 on the Grain Bank Deposit Account | 45.00 |
| the two middle programmes | 5000 bushels | 2 business days | 15.00 | 60.00 |
| the Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 10000 bushels | 3 business days | 15.00 | 75.00 |
| the Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 15000 bushels | 5 business days | 25.00 | 125.00 |

## Illustration on hypothetical quantities

An order of 4200 bushels reaches the smallest load-out posted for the Open Storage Account, at 1000 bushels, and for the Grain Bank Deposit Account, at 500 bushels, but not the 5000 bushels posted for the Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage or the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement, nor the 10000 and 15000 bushels posted for the two highest programmes. Worked out of a Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement on three trucks inside the posted hours, an order would carry 15.00 for each truck, which is 45.00 in truck charges, and nothing for out-of-hours work; taken outside the posted hours it would carry 75.00 as well, raised once on the order rather than on each truck.
